flow.caveat: LegalShield surfaces and organizes facts — it does not make legal arguments on your behalf. Lawyer review is always a separate, optional step.

security.title: Encrypt first. Verify everything. Make false claims impossible.
security.subtitle: Our public copy matches our technical behavior — no military-grade marketing, no zero-knowledge hand-waving.

cse.title: Client-side encryption
cse.body: Files are encrypted on your device before upload. The server stores ciphertext only.

noForge.title: AI never declares forgery
noForge.body: AI surfaces unusual characteristics. It never labels a document as fake or fraudulent.

noVerdict.title: No lawyer verdicts
noVerdict.body: We help you organize. A licensed professional gives opinions. We don't blur that line.

export.title: Export anytime
export.body: Your data is yours. Download a complete evidence package whenever you want.

delete.title: Delete on request

model.title: Envelope encryption, by design
model.subtitle: Every file is encrypted on the client. The server sees ciphertext and metadata — not the document.

items.label: Per-file key
items.body: A fresh AES-256-GCM data key protects each file.

items.label: Key wrapping
items.body: Per-file keys are wrapped with a key hierarchy derived from your password and a recovery key.

items.label: Server storage
items.body: Only encrypted bytes and wrapped key material are stored. Plaintext never leaves your device.

items.label: Hashing
items.body: SHA-256 of plaintext is computed before encryption for integrity.

boundaries.title: What we will never claim
items: "Zero-knowledge" — only after a formal security review demonstrates it.
"Military-grade encryption" — we describe the actual primitives instead.
"100% private" — providers we use (e.g. OCR) are listed in the privacy policy.

how.title: A workflow designed to be honest
how.intro: Every step is built so the system can never quietly turn your uncertainty into a conclusion. AI observations are labeled. Facts and allegations are visually separated. Lawyer review is a separate, optional step.

stages.title: Set up your workspace
stages.body: Create an account, choose your default language and jurisdiction, and you're ready.

stages.title: Preserve what you have
stages.body: Upload evidence. Each file is hashed and encrypted on your device. The original is never modified.

stages.title: Organize by meaning
stages.body: Build a timeline, mark facts vs allegations, attach evidence to each event.

stages.title: Reconcile and request
stages.body: Match claims to receipts, then draft a neutral request to your lawyer for the missing pieces.

stages.title: Verify and decide
stages.body: Use official-channel guides to verify what you can. Decide what's still uncertain.

stages.title: Request professional review
stages.body: Generate a Lawyer Review Package and send it to an independent lawyer.

about.title: We build software for clients, not against lawyers
about.intro: LegalShield was started because too many people feel they have lost the thread of their own case — not because the law failed them, but because the information around it scattered. We help clients organize, preserve, and decide what to verify. We don't replace a lawyer. We make the work between you and a lawyer calmer, clearer, and more honest.

privacy.title: Privacy notice
privacy.intro: This page is a product specification. The legally binding text is the Privacy Policy in your account settings and on file with our counsel. The plan is described below.

sections.heading: What we collect
sections.body: Account information (email, hashed password), profile preferences (language, default jurisdiction), case data you create, evidence files (encrypted on your device), and technical metadata (timestamps, IP addresses for security only).

sections.heading: What we do not collect
sections.body: We do not collect your plaintext evidence. We do not build advertising profiles. We do not sell your data.

sections.heading: Processors
sections.body: We use Supabase for authentication, database, and storage; a transactional email provider for notifications; an AI provider for OCR/extraction. Each is bound by a data-processing agreement and listed here.

sections.heading: Your rights
sections.body: You can export your full data, request deletion, or correct your profile. Email privacy@legalshield.app.

sections.heading: Retention
sections.body: Default retention is as long as your account is active. You can set a per-case retention period or delete any case at any time.

terms.title: Terms of service
terms.intro: This is a product specification. The legally binding Terms will be reviewed by qualified counsel in Kuwait and Jordan before launch.

sections.heading: Not a law firm
sections.body: LegalShield provides organizational, informational, and technology services. It does not provide legal advice or representation, and use of the platform does not create an attorney-client relationship.

sections.heading: User responsibility
sections.body: You are responsible for the accuracy of information you submit and for decisions you make based on platform outputs.

sections.heading: AI limitation
sections.body: AI outputs may contain errors and must be independently verified.

sections.heading: No authenticity determination
sections.body: An AI anomaly report is not a forensic certification.

sections.heading: No outcome guarantee
sections.body: LegalShield does not guarantee a response, recovery, court result, professional outcome, or acceptance of any document.

sections.heading: Third-party lawyers
sections.body: Independent lawyers are responsible for their own professional services.
